bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 151 (Friday, September 27, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mrs. DINGELL:
H.R. 9864.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The Constitutional authority of Congress to enact this
legislation is provided by Article I, Section 8 of the United
States Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to
prohibit the introduction or delivery for introduction into
interstate commerce of food packaging containing
intentionally added PFAS, and for other purposes.
[Page H5839]

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
